north_star: Learned causal world models that transfer persistent variable/entity bindings and interventions to unfamiliar graph families, with complete native resource parity and zero hard false positives.
hypothesis: TRAIN-only reusable relational event statistics can form compact proof-carrying hypothesis states across partially observable nonlinear multi-entity worlds, allowing safer and cheaper prospective counterfactual inference than equally TRAIN-informed full symbolic and frequency-weighted controls, without cueing on entity IDs or source family.
structural_novelty: Eight entities with latent directed two-parent conditional causal update functions, masked partial trajectory observations, multi-step interventions and exact certified counterfactual abstention. This is NOT finite S3 permutation composition, query-priority/motif cache, or a four-role public-pair puzzle.

world_algebra.latent_parent_pairs: each target has two distinct parents, excluding itself
world_algebra.transition: simultaneous next[j]=old[j] XOR gate(old[parentA],old[parentB]), intervention optionally overrides resulting state of one target
world_algebra.partial_observations: source draws one-step transition probes with full pre-state, but post-state reveals masked subset of targets
world_algebra.target_belief_exact: set of all hypothesis pairs+gates consistent with all observed public probes; no hidden latent label may enter candidate
world_algebra.intervention_query: two consecutive transitions under a source-provided intervention schedule, 3 selected target predictions per case
world_algebra.proof: interval-set forward propagation over all consistent per-node hypotheses is conservative; issue an answer only when every reachable state for that target is singleton. May abstain; no guessing.
world_algebra.minimum_information_headroom: before prospective use, confirm on public TRAIN cases that at least 20% of counterfactual target queries have nontrivial unresolved parent hypotheses, a measured information gap from a full graph oracle; do not select or modify DEV based on outcomes.

experiment.fresh_family_P: Causal fan-in / competing mediator graphs under limited partial observation, hidden nonlinear AND/OR rules
experiment.fresh_family_Q: Long-range cross-entity feedback chains and intervention-conditional branching with unfamiliar node permutations
experiment.source_authoring: internal source-only file without candidate imports, not external replication
experiment.public_training: world probing traces and counterfactual words/input intervention schedule with no hidden graph or target truths
experiment.DEV_visibility: public masked probes, intervention plan, visible initial state; hidden graph, latent gates and private counterfactual targets only to scorer
experiment.prior_cohorts_excluded: all T16–T24 DEV and protected source families

comparators: All four are exact safe online inference under same public observations; exact symbolic strongest fully trained baseline sees identical TRAIN. If one cannot prove a target value from public evidence it must abstain and be retained as ineligible, never converted into a guessed success.

predeclared_outcomes.minimum_correctness: zero hard false positives and zero baseline correctly certified losses
predeclared_outcomes.strict_learned_capability_gain: more independently provable correct counterfactual answers than the strongest fully trained symbolic control without reducing safety
predeclared_outcomes.or_strict_learned_efficiency_gain: identical proven correct coverage, but lower complete CPU and no peak RSS regression, with genuine learned rather than algorithmic-only advantage over the equally TRAIN-informed frequency control
predeclared_outcomes.CPU: 5 independent complete-process repeats per arm on Windows and Linux; include TRAIN, source generation, world interpretation, posterior, proof and fallback
predeclared_outcomes.peak_memory: whole-process peak RSS nonregression on both OS
predeclared_outcomes.no_hindsight: No DEV retuning, source reseeding, discarded failures, or replay
predeclared_outcomes.scientific_acceptance: only original prospective, source-blind, resource-qualified evidence; no external replication claimed and no optimizer adoption

gate_sequence: T25-B birth new internal source families separate from model
T25-C qualify TRAIN-only exact abstract causal-world beliefs on both hosted OS; DEV unopened
T25-D run original prospective DEV once after all code and source SHA frozen if preflight passes
T25-E independently retain exact original provider result and negative evidence
